photon-energy.def: The energy of one photon, E = hν = hc/λ, where h = 6.626 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s is Planck's constant. Energy levels are quantized, so only photons of matching energy are absorbed or emitted.

speed-of-light.def: c = 2.998 × 10⁸ m/s, the speed of all electromagnetic radiation in a vacuum; c = λν links wavelength and frequency.
